record_title: Finite-time absorption of OSGM-SGD under persistent discrete gradient noise
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: One-dimensional local result for an equal-curvature quadratic with exact full-objective values, finite nonzero discrete gradient-noise support, candidate stepsizes [0,1/a], and hypergradient learning rate 1/a. The finite-time repeated-atom mechanism does not cover nonatomic continuous noise, general smooth objectives, unknown curvature, or noisy function values. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
